fields.System.Title: OUT-201 — Allocate a line to available stock
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a warehouse manager, I want orders matched to specific stock automatically, so that
pickers are told exactly which location to go to.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given an order line and sufficient available stock, when allocation runs, then
  • reservations are created against specific locations and batches, and the line becomes
  • allocated.
  • - Given candidate stock, then quarantined, damaged, blocked-location, expired, and
  • virtual-location stock is excluded.
  • - Given several candidates, then the Stage 2 rule is oldest receipt date first.
  • - Given insufficient stock, then the line is handled by
  • [OUT-202](OUT-202-partial-allocation-and-backorder.md), not silently left alone.
  • - Given allocation succeeds, then outbound.order_allocated is published.
  • - Given allocation, then it reads real balances, never the availability projection.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | outbound, inventory |
| Tables | order_line, allocation, reservation, stock_balance |
| Risks | Double allocation ([doc 09 §4.1](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)); allocating from a projection ([doc 09 §12](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration · concurrency (mandatory) · invariant |
